summary: Independent max-tier review of task 008 (5 fresh read-only dispatches; codex in quota cooldown, so claude-opus-5-5 xhigh) found 4 blocking defects across rounds, all corrected with reverting regression tests: id-less items covering any obligation (F01), unbounded gridSpan DoS (F02), sdt/customXml-wrapped rows/cells dropped (F03), hierarchical ids truncated so one item covered siblings (R4-01). Also fixed: identity-based contradictions, split-block obligation mapping, UTF-8-only XML, mandatory v2 pins with raw-source re-derivation at package/consumption, fail-fast digest audit, unsupported-structure and zero-obligation acknowledgements, worker guidance and docs. Final dispatch 5 approved with 0 blocking; declared checks pass. Remaining non-blocking findings are recorded as open.

acceptance_coverage.description: Actual fresh reviewer provider/model/effort and reviewed input hashes are recorded.
No unresolved critical/high finding remains; the assigned acceptance cases have actual test evidence.
A reused or fabricated review receipt is rejected.
A frontier reviewer is accepted only with recorded repeated max-review failure; a reused review session or dispatch is rejected.

findings.title: Coverage audit treats a missing obligation_id as a match for every obligation without an explicit ID
findings.resolution: Only non-empty ids match; per-id reasons

findings.title: Unbounded w:gridSpan lets a tiny DOCX hang extraction or exhaust memory
findings.resolution: gridSpan/gridBefore/row extent capped at 64; fail fast

findings.title: Valid OOXML wrappers silently drop text, including whole table rows and cells, with no unsupported_structures record
findings.resolution: sdt/customXml wrappers traversed; run AlternateContent, math, altChunk, moves, unhandled text recorded

findings.title: Contradictions are only checked for presence, so individual contradictions can be dropped
Obligations from blocks split across fragments are assigned to the first fragment only
findings.resolution: Clause located in the fragment that holds it

findings.title: DTD/ENTITY check can be bypassed with UTF-16 encoded document.xml
Integrity checks are optional when fields are absent, and the raw source and block stream are not re-verified at consumption
findings.resolution: Mandatory v2 pins; raw-source re-derivation at package/consumption

findings.title: Primary-plan task guidance does not tell workers about the new validator contracts
Several negative tests would not fail if the guard they target were removed
Coverage matching heuristics can drop polarity and match on mere ID references
findings.resolution: Extraction-side explicit_id = first id in clause (fail-safe over-reporting); deferred

findings.title: read_fragment returns text from a later read that is not checked against the recorded hash
w:gridBefore/w:gridAfter are ignored, so column anchors and vMerge tracking are misaligned
Recall, contradiction-preservation and unsupported-structure claims go beyond what the code delivers
Split Markdown requirement tables map every row obligation to every spanned fragment
findings.resolution: Markdown rows located by raw line

findings.title: Recorded unsupported structures, including tracked insertions in table cells, are never gated by coverage review
Coverage audit still accepts content-free id echoes and short substrings
validate-digest does not audit its own batch's obligations, so resume marks incomplete digests complete
Digest contradictions without an id are carried by any carrier that shares a source ref
Two documentation claims slightly exceed the code
Source re-verification can be downgraded through the unpinned package.json original_path
Evidence state for the 009 gate
findings.resolution: Fresh logs and pinned hashes in this receipt

findings.title: R2-03 content-word rule can falsely reject faithful digests; guidance and error do not explain it
findings.resolution: Language-neutral restatement rule; per-id reasons; guidance

findings.title: Id strings count as content words, so content-free echoes still cover RULE-/CLAUSE-/R### obligations
Inline tracked insertions are dropped from paragraph text, so the remaining text can enter evidence with inverted meaning
findings.resolution: Tracked insertions/moves recorded, not merged, as the decision allows; inverted-polarity warning documented

findings.title: Obligation floor recognises only English modals and fixed id prefixes; other sources get a vacuous audit with no warning
Digest contradiction ids are not unique, so colliding ids let one carrier satisfy several contradictions
Unsupported-structure acknowledgement collapses entries and can crash with TypeError
R2-06 a:t and the R2-07 CLI flag have no reverting regression test
Evidence state for the 009 gate
Hierarchical ids (REQ-7.1, FR-1.2.3, REQ-007-A) are truncated to a shared explicit_id, so one digest item covers every sibling obligation
findings.resolution: Hierarchical ids extracted whole; shared ids ambiguous (canonical id or text only)

findings.title: 'Any language' restatement rule falsely rejects CJK/Thai paraphrases
Contradiction-id prefix is documented as a rule but not enforced; collisions surface only at synthesis
findings.resolution: Digest-prefixed contradiction ids enforced in validate-digest

findings.title: Obligation-floor gate is keyed to unpinned block_count and only to zero obligations
findings.resolution: Floor gate keyed to fragments; block_count re-derived

findings.title: Restatement check is a word count; filler with the right id passes
findings.resolution: Word-count restatement is a documented trade-off; semantic fidelity is the coverage reviewer's job

findings.title: R3-03 accepted as a recorded limitation; docs match code
Evidence state for the 009 gate
One digest item can still satisfy several obligations through mismatched canonical_id, obligation_id and leading text id
The 60% substring path lets one truncated item cover sibling clauses and drop their qualifier
Two R4 fixes have no test that fails when they are reverted; one test comment is stale
The 'any language' restatement rule still falsely rejects short Indic-script restatements
R4-01 to R4-06 are fixed in the current code, and R4-01/02/03 have reverting tests
Evidence state for the 009 gate

supersedes.note: 008 outcome claims (ooxml-text-v2, count-based contradiction preservation, text-box recording) are stale; this receipt and 009-outcome.md describe the reviewed code.

limitations: No live model digest comparison or paid benchmark (G002); compare-baselines measures deterministic fragmentation losslessness only; no cost/quality gain is claimed.
Reviewers were read-only and ran no tests; codex was unavailable (quota) for every dispatch, so all reviews used claude-opus-5-5 xhigh.
Obligation floor is a heuristic (English modals, fixed id prefixes); zero-obligation sources require acknowledged_obligation_floor.
Tracked insertions/moves are recorded, not merged; reviewers must check previews for inverted polarity.
Raw-source re-derivation reports 'unavailable' when the source is gone unless --require-source is passed.
Open non-blocking findings: R5-01 (medium) and R5-02/R5-03/R5-04 (low); F10 extraction side deferred.
The prepared report is input evidence only, not proof that this implementation or its review passed.
